title: A contact version of Kirby's theorem
summary: A theorem of Ding and Geiges states that every closed, connected contact $3$-manifold can be obtained from the standard tight contact $3$-sphere by contact $(\pm1)$-surgery along a Legendrian link. The literature also contains some examples of contact Kirby moves, i.e. explicit operations on front projections of Legendrian surgery links that change the surgery link but preserve the contactomorphism type of the surgered manifold.
